about: Parked decisions replayed by src/contracts/decision.test.ts through parseDecision: park files as agents write them (unversioned, what they are asked for), a scout's structured question (version 1), and a saved decision row's fields re-read as a payload. The installed database (~/.config/standing-orders/orders.db) was not readable from the build that wrote this file (read-only access was denied), so no row here is copied from it; each sample names the writer or test whose shape it records.
